capitals.note: 'Muddu Raja ... initially ruled from the town of Haleri.'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the page gives no area or boundary, so Coorg is the Kodagu country around Haleri and Mercara (a 40 km disc, about 5,000 km2 on the grid; the Kodagu district is about 4,100 km2, a figure not on the pages opened). Mysore's occupation of 1780-1788 is a hatched overlay in the ledger.

ledger.note: 1633: the first dated reign. The page says only that Coorg was 'an independent kingdom in India from the 16th century until 1834', ruled by a branch of the Ikkeri Nayaka family, and that Muddu Raja ruled from 1633 to 1687 'initially from the town of Haleri'. 1633 is the first year the page dates; the founding year is not on any page opened.
1681: Muddu Raja moves the capital from Haleri to Mercara (Madikeri), where he 'fortified it and built a palace there in 1681'.

1780: Mysore occupies Coorg. The page says Coorg 'was invaded by Hyder Ali of Mysore and the state was annexed' and 'from 1780 to 1788, the kingdom was occupied by neighbouring Mysore' (elsewhere the conquest is put in 1768, uncited).
1788: 'through British intervention, the Raja of Coorg regained his kingdom'.

11 March 1834: 'the Northern Division under Colonel Gilbert Waugh entered Coorg territory' (a force of 7,000 under Brigadier General Lindsay had been assembled in February); the first contact was on 3 April.
10 April 1834: 'the Raja who was in Nalknad palace entered Madikeri fort with his wives and surrendered to the British.'

1834: the Kingdom of Coorg ends. 'After the Raja rebelled, the British annexed the kingdom the same year, and it became Coorg Province.' Chikka Virarajendra was the last Raja; the page gives no annexation day (the surrender was 10 April).

wars.name: Anglo-Mysore occupation of Coorg
wars.outcome: Hyder Ali's Mysore occupied Coorg 1780-1788; British intervention restored the Raja in 1788.
wars.note: The page also puts the conquest in 1768 (uncited).

wars.name: Coorg War
wars.outcome: The Company's forces entered Coorg on 11 March 1834 and took the Raja's surrender at Madikeri on 10 April; Coorg annexed as a province.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary; the kingdom is a hill country drawn as a 40 km disc.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 by sa-06-x. A state Cliopatria lacks: cliopatria_names empty, one new keyframe. Two pages opened (Kingdom of Kodagu, Coorg War); 'Haleri dynasty' returned url_not_found. WebFetch returned extracts.

Founding: the page says only 'from the 16th century'; the first dated reign is Muddu Raja's (1633-1687), so 1633 is the start at confidence 1. The ruler list is incomplete on the page (Dodda Virappa 1687-1736, Chikka Virappa to 1768 without a start, Chikka Virarajendra last), so no ruler strip. The page says Coorg beat a Mysore army at Palupare and hostilities resumed in 1724 (no dates for the first fight).

Disagreement: the page puts Mysore's conquest at 1768 (Haidar Ali, uncited) and at 1780 ('invaded by Hyder Ali ... annexed'; 'from 1780 to 1788 the kingdom was occupied'); 1780 is used. The Mysore row of Cliopatria (kingdom-of-mysore dossier, sa-05) records the 1792 loss of Coorg's independence claim differently: it has Tipu losing 'Coorg (Kodagu) under its rajah' to a 1792 settlement, which this page does not mention. The East India Company page (Company rule in India) dates the annexation 'Coorg annexed (1834)'.

Area: none on the pages; the 40 km disc is 5,000 km2 on the grid and the Kodagu district is about 4,100 km2 (not a page opened). Gazetteer: Haleri and Madikeri/Mercara are absent from places.jsonl; coordinates used (75.74 E 12.42 N).
